name: waku
description: Waku Memory: durable memory that follows you across sessions, agents and computers. memory.search finds what is known about a task; memory.remember keeps what matters. When you ask, it also saves your agent setup (MCP servers, plugins, connectors and scheduled tasks, with every secret removed first), so that a new computer or account can be set up the same way. This version of the plugin runs no hooks, so nothing is sent until the agent calls a tool or you ask it to save your setup. What the agent passes to a tool is sent to Waku's servers and on to the AI providers that make it searchable, named at www.waku.one/privacy. This is an alpha and its data can be lost.
